description: Wait for a long-running job and return the resolved result — a bounded long-poll. Includes template preparation (kind="template", id=jobId), media import, render, compose, consult, suggestions and preview. If still running, call wait_job again with the same arguments; work continues server-side.

id.description: kind="media": mediaItemId returned by import/generate/finalize/import_resource. kind="render": renderId. kind="compose": composeJobId. kind="consult": consultJobId. kind="suggestions": mediaItemId. Generic kinds use the jobId from the enqueue receipt.

imageIndices.description: Read these 1–4 original zero-based image artifact indices from this completed job, in this order. Does not render again. Same arguments repeat the same selection; omit for the first four.

kind.description: What to wait on, including template preparation (kind="template").

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in ms (default 30 min for render/compose, 5 min for suggestions).

name: wait_job
title: Wait for Job
